editorial.blurb: A tucked-away gem serving exceptionally flavorful, authentic pho with rich broth and genuine hospitality that keeps people coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Call ahead for takeout and ask them to separate your broth, noodles, and vegetables—they're happy to accommodate, and it's perfect for first-timers or those new to pho.

topDishes.note: Incredibly flavorful broth with rich, aromatic depth and generous portions
Artfully made with shrimp, pork, and vegetables cut in varying sizes
A perfect complement to the meal, beloved by regulars
